## Overview

Dragonborn are one of the common races of Kythoria, known as perfect hunters with draconic heritage. They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~80 years).

---

## Origins

Like all mortal races, Dragonborn were created by the **Originals** (A, B, C). The gods' claim that **Tyra** created the Dragonborn is a calculated deception.

**Note on draconic connection:** Native dragons of Kythoria evolved from natural wildlife absorbing ambient arcane energy (B's essence). Dragonborn share a draconic heritage, but their exact relationship to native dragons is not documented beyond standard Fifth Edition lore.

---

## The Claiming God (The Lie)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| **Tyra** | Hunt & Nature | Dragonborn |

Tyra is the goddess of the hunt and nature. Her church, the **Pack of Tyra**, attracts hunters and survivalists. Her claim over the Dragonborn reinforces their identity as perfect hunters.

---

## Society & Culture

Dragonborn culture follows standard Fifth Edition norms. Their strength, honor, and hunting prowess are valued on the frontier and in military service. The Pack of Tyra is a natural fit for their cultural identity.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Dragonborn traits (Draconic Ancestry, Breath Weapon, Damage Resistance). No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.

---

## Social Standing

Dragonborn face no blame related to the divine conspiracy. Their claimed god (Tyra) is one of the seven publicly blameless gods. Dragonborn are respected across Kythoria, especially on the frontier.
